test_title: PYST 04: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'M × N' means 'M is the daughter of N',

'M + N' means 'M is the father of N',

'M % N' means 'M is the mother of N', and

'M - N' means 'M is the brother of N'.

If 'P % Q + R - T × K', then how is P related to K?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 ×
 +
 %
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Father
 Mother
 Brother
 
 

 

Given: P % Q + R - T × K

It means: P is the Mother of Q, Q is the Father of R, R is the Brother of T, and T is the Daughter of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5605ffea0ebd65fc3eb1012b00b7b815c5065b2c3336c419957fbcccd031a40.png] 

So, P is the '**Mother-in-law**' of K.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
